SELECT
    t.channel_key,
    c.display_name AS channel_name,
    COUNT(t.account_transaction_fact_key) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction AS t
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_channel AS c ON t.channel_key = c.channel_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS d ON t.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY
    t.channel_key, 
    c.display_name
ORDER BY
    transaction_count DESC;

FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute AS t1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.business_id) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = f.business_date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer AS c ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key
WHERE f.default_flag = TRUE
  AND d.calendar_date = (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_day.calendar_date)
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS snapshot_fact
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS snapshot_day ON snapshot_day.date_key = snapshot_fact.business_date_key
    WHERE snapshot_day.calendar_year_number = 2025
      AND snapshot_day.month_number = 8
  );

SELECT
  t2.display_name AS complaint_category,
  COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_complaint AS t1

JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS t3 ON t1.business_date_key = t3.date_key
WHERE
  t3.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY
  t2.display_name;
